name: Dominican Pollo Guisado
tagline: Cozy, saucy chicken with a taste of home.
steps: Season chicken with lime, garlic and oregano.
Add chopped vegetables and tomato sauce.
Simmer gently until chicken is cooked through.

name: Coconut Red Snapper
tagline: Island-inspired fish with creamy coconut sauce.
steps: Season fish with lime, salt and pepper.
Cook fish and shrimp fully in the sauce.

name: Crispy Chicken Flautas
tagline: Crunchy tortillas wrapped around seasoned chicken.
steps: Warm tortillas and roll with chicken.

name: Mangu with Onions
steps: Peel and boil plantains until tender.
Mash with a little cooking water and oil.
Spoon onions over mangú and serve.
